sentences: A subcube partition divides all Boolean inputs into monochromatic pieces, each specified by fixing some coordinates.
Unlike a decision tree, the pieces need not arise from one sequential hierarchy of queries.
The source separates this partition model from randomized decision trees and asks for the strongest possible gap between their complexities.
Even the comparison with deterministic query complexity is included in the question.
Determining the extremal separation would quantify how much harder it is to discover an input's certificate adaptively than merely to exhibit a globally consistent collection of certificates.
